sites.name: extended-sprite-texture-dispatch
sites.find:
if ((widget_flags & FRONTEND_WIDGET_FLAG_HIGHLIGHTED) != 0) {
            queue_axis_aligned_textured_quad_uv(
                sprite_hot_texture_id,
                texture_hit_x + wobble - pad,
                texture_hit_y - pad,
                texture_hit_width + border_edge,
                texture_hit_height + border_edge,
                0x1000000,
                &current_text_color,
                0.0f,
                0.0f,
                1.0f,
                1.0f,
                texture_layer,
                0);
        } else {
            queue_axis_aligned_textured_quad_uv(
                texture_id,
                texture_hit_x + wobble - pad,
                texture_hit_y - pad,
                texture_hit_width + border_edge,
                texture_hit_height + border_edge,
                0x1000000,
                &current_text_color,
                0.0f,
                0.0f,
                1.0f,
                1.0f,
                texture_layer,
                0);
        }
